messages:
tara: Quick sync 1 ACME asked for less noisy error surfaces and clearer cost context. Can we scope a small sprint to ship a tenant-gated error signal compact?
kevin: define "compact" + non-negotiables from product POV pls.
maria: must-haves from PM: (a) single error-summary widget per-tenant (route heatmap + cost band legend), (b) expose top-k sampled traces grouped by cost band, (c) an opt-out rule for infra noise. No new full pages.
josh: runtime note: we can add a tracing hook that marks spans with cost_band and noisy=true; sampling at 8-12% keeps perf impact minimal.
lisa: UX idea: one compact tile with 3 lanes: heatmap (routes x error rate), cost slider (low/med/high), inline trace peek. Clicking a trace shows the full span in the existing trace viewer.
sahil: commercial/ops: ACME will sign a short-term premium for 30d retention if we guarantee query P95 < 600ms. We should include that in acceptance criteria.
maria: scope constraints: avoid index rewrites if possible. Can we implement cost_band faceting by precomputing cost_band tag at ingestion without schema migration?
josh: yes, we can tag at ingestion and add a lightweight facet in the trace-store metadata. Estimate: 2 dev days runtime, 2 infra days to add facet + retention policy.
tara: launch gating proposal: (1) passes staging perf check (P95 < 600ms on synthetic load), (2) top-k recall eval >= 85% at sampling default (10%), (3) ACME validation run complete.
kevin: prioritization: this is a customer-driven quick win. If infra estimate holds, bump to next sprint. If infra blows up, deprioritize.
lisa: tiny API sketch: GET /console/tenants/{id}/errors?cost_band=high&top=5 returns precomputed trace refs. Keep response tiny.
josh: config snippet for canary:```yaml
tracing_hooks:
  - name: error_signal_band
    condition: "status >= 500"
    sample_rate: 0.10
    annotate:
      - cost_band: computed
      - noisy: false
```
maria: acceptance test: create synthetic traffic with injected high-cost 5xx and verify top-5 list contains the injected traces at default sampling in 4/5 runs.
sahil: budget concern: storing top-10 full traces for all tenants would be ~40GB/day; we should cap to top-5 by default and allow tenant override with chargeback.
josh: agree on top-5 cap. I'll add alerting if daily delta > 32GB.
tara: rollout plan: feature-flagged opt-in per-tenant; start with ACME, monitor 72h, then open opt-in. Add a Console toggle for retention tier.
infra-team-bot: scheduled canary: feature/error-signal-compact -> staging at 4792345700. Runbook: /runbooks/feature-error-signal-canary.md
kevin: add one item: docs + short query performance benchmark pushed to docs before ACME roll.
maria: I'll draft the PRD and the ACME validation checklist. Estimation summary in PRD: runtime 2d, infra 2d, console UX 2d, QA 1d. Total 7d.
tara: ok green-light to schedule the 7d work in next sprint pending infra confirms the 2d estimate. @josh please ack cap/alert config and we'll move this to the sprint board.
josh: acked. cap/top-5 + alerting configured.
tara: resolved for planning. keep thread open for post-canary notes. :white_check_mark:
